title: 第2章 完了！穿越到老太监的漫画里了！
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

接下来几天，贺舟一直试图找出这个城市的边界，也一直在观察这本漫画番的评论。

可以确定的是…

他们那边也不是自己原本的世界。

而是一个漫画盛行的世界，读者提到的都是自己不知道的漫画。

整个岛十分大，北边大部分城区在修路进不去。

因为小岛夜晚不允许出门的缘故，放学格外早。

他翘课一天，坐车到沙滩附近时，贺舟终于看到了这座岛的边界。

远远看去。

海面上有一层灰色的雾笼罩在海天接壤处的边缘，神秘又危险。

光是看着那一层灰雾，都让人心悸。

糟糕的是。

在连着观察几天后，贺舟隐约感觉到那一层灰雾似乎挪动了。

自从观察到岛屿附近被灰雾笼罩时，贺舟就有些焦虑了。

越是观察，越是心惊。

而每天晚上。

整个雾岛就如同规则怪谈一般，陷入了完全的寂静中。

晚上没睡着时，能隐约透过窗帘和窗户听到窗户后边令人汗毛倒立的呼呼声。

不知道是风声，还是野兽的喘息声。

恐怖至极。

这么下去不行。

今天上课时，贺舟又在走神思考对策。

一边思考，一边无意识地随手在书页上画了一只奶牛猫。

漫画世界的改剧情容易，可得有读者看。

演恋爱番也不行，观察了几天了，女主这只小猫只要有人靠近就一脸要反击，仿佛要上去给一个大逼兜的模样，大家根本不敢靠近。

这个作者挂的热血番的标签，恋爱番戏份估计大家不买账。

去演战斗热血番更不行。

人主角那是有主角不死定律的！

自己一个NPC，几条命啊，敢跟主角不死定律去碰？

那这本漫画的人气怎么办，他怎么样才能提高这本漫画的人气？

灰雾应该跟漫画人气相关。

彻底没人看的时候，估计整个世界都会消失。

那自己呢？

是不是也会消失？

“哎…”

“难搞。”

贺舟叹了口气，低头一看。

纸上画的那只奶牛猫有着黑白相间的毛发，是一个十分简单的简笔画。

为了搭配这个奶牛猫简笔画，他还随意地在旁边画了一个黑猫警长。

刷刷刷…

画得起劲时，忽然一道视线射过来。

贺舟停笔好奇地一扭头，恰好看到同桌江黛圆溜溜的眼睛盯着自己画的那只简笔奶牛猫和黑猫警长。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the next few days, He Zhou kept trying to find out the boundaries of the city and observing the comments on this comic book.

What is certain is…

Their side is not their original world.

It’s a world where comics are prevalent, and readers mention comics they don’t know about.

The entire island is very large, and most of the urban areas in the north are inaccessible due to road construction.

Because the island is not allowed to go out at night, school ends very early.

He skipped school for a day and when he took a car to the beach, He Zhou finally saw the boundary of the island.

Look from afar.

There is a layer of gray fog on the sea covering the edge of the sea and sky, mysterious and dangerous.

Just looking at that layer of gray fog makes one's heart palpitate.

The bad thing is.

After several days of continuous observation, He Zhou vaguely felt that the layer of gray fog seemed to have moved.

He Zhou had become a little anxious since he observed that the island was shrouded in gray fog.

The more I observed, the more frightened I became.

And every night.

The entire Kirishima fell into complete silence like a strange rule.

When I'm awake at night, I can vaguely hear a hair-raising whirring sound behind the window through the curtains and windows.

I don’t know if it’s the sound of wind or the breathing of wild animals.

Extremely terrifying.

This cannot continue.

During class today, He Zhou was distracted and thinking about countermeasures.

While thinking about it, I unconsciously drew a cow cat on the page.

It’s easy to change the plot in the comic book world, but you have to have readers.

It’s not good to act in a love scene. After observing it for a few days, the heroine, a kitten, always looks like she’s going to fight back whenever someone comes near her, as if she’s about to go up and give a big dick to her. No one dares to get close to her at all.

This author has labeled it a hot-blooded drama, and I guess people won't buy it because of the love drama.

It’s even more inappropriate to act in a hot-blooded battle series.

There is a law of immortality for human protagonists!

I am an NPC, how many lives do I have, how dare I challenge the protagonist's law of immortality?

So what to do about the popularity of this comic? How can he improve the popularity of this comic?

Gray Mist should be related to the popularity of comics.

When no one is watching, the whole world will probably disappear.

What about yourself?

Will it disappear too?

"Hey..."

"Difficult."

He Zhou sighed and looked down.

The cow cat drawn on the paper has black and white hair. It is a very simple sketch.

To match the simple drawing of a cow cat, he also casually drew a black cat sergeant next to it.

Brush brush brush…

When I was getting excited about painting, a line of sight suddenly came over me.

He Zhou stopped writing and turned his head curiously, just in time to see his deskmate Jiang Dai's round eyes staring at the simple cow cat and black cat police chief he had drawn.
